name: Cache-Less Memory (CLM)
definition: A system design that allows large or highly detailed scenes to be trained/rendered on a single consumer-grade GPU by offloading Gaussian parameters and optimizer computation to the CPU, while leveraging sparsity and spatial locality to reduce GPU-CPU communication overhead.
summary: Cache-Less Memory is a 3D Gaussian Splatting system that offloads non-critical attributes to the CPU to fit large scenes on consumer GPUs, distinguishing itself by explicit attribute partitioning rather than caching strategies.
